blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate is eyeing to issue a resolution over the Chinese embassy’s challenge to Filipino lawmakers to declare Ambassador Jing Quan persona non grata over his remarks about using force against the Philippines, Sen. Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito said on Sunday. “We are already discussing whether we will pass a resolution regarding his remarks. But most likely, the Senate will take action and a resolution regarding this,” Ejercito said in an interview with radio dzBB. Ejercito said Jing’s statement were “very rude, hostile, and undiplomatic,” after the latter earlier said China could easily defeat the Philippines if it chose […]...
